channel.title: First Principles Daily Blog
channel.description: Blog posts from First Principles Daily podcast episodes.

item.title: Routine legal documents costing thousands today have an Idiot Index in the thousands because their raw-material cost is essentially zero.
item.description: Routine legal documents costing thousands today have an Idiot Index in the thousands because their raw-material cost is essentially zero.

item.title: For a century every photograph carried a real cost in silver, chemicals, and paper; silicon sensors collapsed the marginal cost of an image to nearly zero by turning photons into charge.
item.description: For a century every photograph carried a real cost in silver, chemicals, and paper; silicon sensors collapsed the marginal cost of an image to nearly zero by turning photons into charge.

item.title: A prosthetic limb billed at fifty thousand dollars contains roughly fifty dollars of plastic and actuators—the gap lives in custom labor and process, not the materials.
item.description: A prosthetic limb billed at fifty thousand dollars contains roughly fifty dollars of plastic and actuators—the gap lives in custom labor and process, not the materials.

item.title: Most food rotted before reaching armies or cities out of season until heat and sealed containers turned harvest abundance into months of usable supply at a small multiple of the raw food cost.
item.description: Most food rotted before reaching armies or cities out of season until heat and sealed containers turned harvest abundance into months of usable supply at a small multiple of the raw food cost.

item.title: Rail moves a ton a mile with far less energy than trucks, yet the cheaper physics mode still loses on delivered cost.
item.description: Rail moves a ton a mile with far less energy than trucks, yet the cheaper physics mode still loses on delivered cost.

item.title: A catalytic converter’s price is set less by its ceramic and steel than by a few grams of platinum, palladium, and rhodium whose scarcity keeps the floor stubbornly high.
item.description: A catalytic converter’s price is set less by its ceramic and steel than by a few grams of platinum, palladium, and rhodium whose scarcity keeps the floor stubbornly high.

item.title: Satellites that reach orbit often cost millions yet contain only thousands of dollars of silicon, aluminum, and electronics — the real expense sits in the process, not the atoms.
item.description: Satellites that reach orbit often cost millions yet contain only thousands of dollars of silicon, aluminum, and electronics — the real expense sits in the process, not the atoms.

item.title: Before the integrated circuit, adding each transistor required another hand-soldered wire; afterward, billions could be printed onto a sliver of purified sand for a few cents.
item.description: Before the integrated circuit, adding each transistor required another hand-soldered wire; afterward, billions could be printed onto a sliver of purified sand for a few cents.

item.title: Raising animals for protein wastes most input energy on the animal’s life; microbes could brew the same molecules for far less.
item.description: Raising animals for protein wastes most input energy on the animal’s life; microbes could brew the same molecules for far less.

item.title: Before the cotton gin, one worker cleaned roughly a pound of fiber per day by hand; the machine that attacked only the seed-separation step raised that output by a factor of fifty almost overnight.
item.description: Before the cotton gin, one worker cleaned roughly a pound of fiber per day by hand; the machine that attacked only the seed-separation step raised that output by a factor of fifty almost overnight.

item.title: A house built from lumber, gypsum, concrete, and glass still costs many times the value of those raw materials because the expense sits in assembly, regulation, and financing rather than in the stuff itself.
item.description: A house built from lumber, gypsum, concrete, and glass still costs many times the value of those raw materials because the expense sits in assembly, regulation, and financing rather than in the stuff itself.

item.title: A watch whose price once tracked hundreds of skilled labor hours now costs a few dollars because engineers replaced the entire mechanism with a vibrating quartz crystal and a silicon chip.
item.description: A watch whose price once tracked hundreds of skilled labor hours now costs a few dollars because engineers replaced the entire mechanism with a vibrating quartz crystal and a silicon chip.

item.title: A ton of old circuit boards already contains more gold than a ton of virgin ore, yet the cost to recover it still sits many times higher than the metals themselves.
item.description: A ton of old circuit boards already contains more gold than a ton of virgin ore, yet the cost to recover it still sits many times higher than the metals themselves.

item.title: Ice once cut from frozen ponds and hauled across oceans now costs pennies to produce anywhere because engineers asked what it truly takes to pump heat out of a box.
item.description: Ice once cut from frozen ponds and hauled across oceans now costs pennies to produce anywhere because engineers asked what it truly takes to pump heat out of a box.

item.title: A package can cross an ocean for pennies per kilogram, yet the last few kilometers to a doorstep often multiply the total cost several times over.
item.description: A package can cross an ocean for pennies per kilogram, yet the last few kilometers to a doorstep often multiply the total cost several times over.

item.title: Battery packs that once cost several thousand dollars per kilowatt-hour now sit near one hundred dollars because teams priced the metals and assembly energy alone and attacked everything else.
item.description: Battery packs that once cost several thousand dollars per kilowatt-hour now sit near one hundred dollars because teams priced the metals and assembly energy alone and attacked everything else.

item.title: A routine dental filling can cost hundreds while the materials inside are worth only a few dollars, showing where the real price drivers sit.
item.description: A routine dental filling can cost hundreds while the materials inside are worth only a few dollars, showing where the real price drivers sit.

item.title: Intricate patterned cloth once demanded teams of skilled hands per row; punched cards collapsed that labor into the cost of thread and a stack of holes.
item.description: Intricate patterned cloth once demanded teams of skilled hands per row; punched cards collapsed that labor into the cost of thread and a stack of holes.

item.title: Cement that binds our buildings costs many times the limestone and fuel alone, because the century-old kiln process itself is the real expense.
item.description: Cement that binds our buildings costs many times the limestone and fuel alone, because the century-old kiln process itself is the real expense.

item.title: Copper cables costing thousands per kilometer gave way to glass strands worth pennies once engineers treated data movement as a purity problem instead of a wiring problem.
item.description: Copper cables costing thousands per kilometer gave way to glass strands worth pennies once engineers treated data movement as a purity problem instead of a wiring problem.

item.title: A mile of subway can cost two billion dollars in one city and a tenth that in another, even with similar rock and water tables, because the raw materials and boring hours explain almost none of the difference.
item.description: A mile of subway can cost two billion dollars in one city and a tenth that in another, even with similar rock and water tables, because the raw materials and boring hours explain almost none of the difference.

item.title: Messages crossed the Atlantic in two weeks by ship until engineers treated the ocean floor itself as the medium and moved a word in minutes.
item.description: Messages crossed the Atlantic in two weeks by ship until engineers treated the ocean floor itself as the medium and moved a word in minutes.

item.title: Burning fuel for heat hits a hard 100% efficiency wall, yet heat pumps routinely deliver three to four times more heat than the electricity they consume by moving heat instead of creating it.
item.description: Burning fuel for heat hits a hard 100% efficiency wall, yet heat pumps routinely deliver three to four times more heat than the electricity they consume by moving heat instead of creating it.

item.title: Before interchangeable parts, a musket cost many times its raw iron and wood because every component had to be hand-fitted by skilled craftsmen.
item.description: Before interchangeable parts, a musket cost many times its raw iron and wood because every component had to be hand-fitted by skilled craftsmen.

item.title: Replacing a lead service line costs thousands of dollars, yet the pipe material itself is worth only tens of dollars — the price is almost entirely in the digging, records, and restoration.
item.description: Replacing a lead service line costs thousands of dollars, yet the pipe material itself is worth only tens of dollars — the price is almost entirely in the digging, records, and restoration.

item.title: Before Gutenberg a book cost as much as a house; afterward the marginal cost of another page fell toward paper and ink alone.
item.description: Before Gutenberg a book cost as much as a house; afterward the marginal cost of another page fell toward paper and ink alone.

item.title: A century after insulin's patent sold for a dollar, vials still list for hundreds despite raw-material costs in the low single digits.
item.description: A century after insulin's patent sold for a dollar, vials still list for hundreds despite raw-material costs in the low single digits.

item.title: The real price of artificial light has fallen roughly ten thousandfold since whale-oil lamps, because each generation measured lumens delivered rather than lamps sold.
item.description: The real price of artificial light has fallen roughly ten thousandfold since whale-oil lamps, because each generation measured lumens delivered rather than lamps sold.

item.title: Most collected recyclables cost more to sort than the raw materials they contain are worth — except for a few that already beat that floor.
item.description: Most collected recyclables cost more to sort than the raw materials they contain are worth — except for a few that already beat that floor.

item.title: Before containers, dock handling often cost more than the sea voyage itself; afterward the entire system converged on the steel-and-fuel floor.
item.description: Before containers, dock handling often cost more than the sea voyage itself; afterward the entire system converged on the steel-and-fuel floor.

item.title: Indoor farms sell lettuce at premium prices, yet the electricity to replace sunlight often exceeds the value of the crop itself.
item.description: Indoor farms sell lettuce at premium prices, yet the electricity to replace sunlight often exceeds the value of the crop itself.

item.title: Two brothers spent a few dollars on fabric and wire to solve aircraft control while rivals spent fortunes on engines that still crashed.
item.description: Two brothers spent a few dollars on fabric and wire to solve aircraft control while rivals spent fortunes on engines that still crashed.

item.title: Geothermal could supply steady power anywhere if the cost of reaching hot rock fell to the price of pipe and steel alone.
item.description: Geothermal could supply steady power anywhere if the cost of reaching hot rock fell to the price of pipe and steel alone.

item.title: Before 1909, nitrogen for crops came from finite mines and seabird droppings; the Haber-Bosch process turned the air itself into an unlimited supply.
item.description: Before 1909, nitrogen for crops came from finite mines and seabird droppings; the Haber-Bosch process turned the air itself into an unlimited supply.

item.title: In 1941 the world’s penicillin could treat only a handful of patients; three years later it covered every Allied casualty on D-Day because the process was rebuilt around oxygen transfer and reactor volume instead of flask surface area.
item.description: In 1941 the world’s penicillin could treat only a handful of patients; three years later it covered every Allied casualty on D-Day because the process was rebuilt around oxygen transfer and reactor volume instead of flask surface area.

item.title: A commercial kitchen build-out can run half a million dollars, yet the raw steel, compressors, and ductwork inside point to a far lower floor.
item.description: A commercial kitchen build-out can run half a million dollars, yet the raw steel, compressors, and ductwork inside point to a far lower floor.

item.title: The first human genome cost billions and took thirteen years; today the same sequence costs a few hundred dollars in hours because someone treated DNA as millions of parallel reactions instead of one at a time.
item.description: The first human genome cost billions and took thirteen years; today the same sequence costs a few hundred dollars in hours because someone treated DNA as millions of parallel reactions instead of one at a time.

item.title: Hearing aids that cost thousands per pair contain electronics worth only tens of dollars; the gap is not the silicon but the bundled model that has kept prices high.
item.description: Hearing aids that cost thousands per pair contain electronics worth only tens of dollars; the gap is not the silicon but the bundled model that has kept prices high.

item.title: An LED bulb that cost fifty dollars in 2010 now sells for a few dollars because its price was driven toward the cost of the semiconductor die and phosphor inside.
item.description: An LED bulb that cost fifty dollars in 2010 now sells for a few dollars because its price was driven toward the cost of the semiconductor die and phosphor inside.

item.title: Prescription glasses retail for hundreds yet contain just dollars of polycarbonate and metal — why hasn't the cost fallen toward the material floor?
item.description: Prescription glasses retail for hundreds yet contain just dollars of polycarbonate and metal — why hasn't the cost fallen toward the material floor?

item.title: In the 1850s aluminum cost more than gold at the table of Napoleon III because no one could separate it cheaply from its oxide.
item.description: In the 1850s aluminum cost more than gold at the table of Napoleon III because no one could separate it cheaply from its oxide.

item.title: Capturing carbon dioxide from air today costs hundreds or thousands of dollars per ton, yet thermodynamics sets an energy floor far below that price.
item.description: Capturing carbon dioxide from air today costs hundreds or thousands of dollars per ton, yet thermodynamics sets an energy floor far below that price.

item.title: Rockets once priced at roughly ten thousand dollars per kilogram to orbit now reach a few thousand through reuse — because the question changed from building expendables cheaper to whether the hardware must be thrown away after one flight.
item.description: Rockets once priced at roughly ten thousand dollars per kilogram to orbit now reach a few thousand through reuse — because the question changed from building expendables cheaper to whether the hardware must be thrown away after one flight.

item.title: Transmission lines that could cost a few times their copper and steel now run many times that because the real expense sits in permits, queues, and custom builds.
item.description: Transmission lines that could cost a few times their copper and steel now run many times that because the real expense sits in permits, queues, and custom builds.

item.title: Traditional vaccines grow and inactivate whole pathogens one disease at a time, but mRNA hands the cell the genetic instructions and lets it make the antigen instead.
item.description: Traditional vaccines grow and inactivate whole pathogens one disease at a time, but mRNA hands the cell the genetic instructions and lets it make the antigen instead.

item.title: A blood test whose reagents cost pennies can still bill for hundreds because the price lives almost entirely outside the materials.
item.description: A blood test whose reagents cost pennies can still bill for hundreds because the price lives almost entirely outside the materials.

item.title: Solar panels that once cost hundreds of dollars per watt now cost cents, because the industry kept asking what the sand, silver, and aluminum alone were worth.
item.description: Solar panels that once cost hundreds of dollars per watt now cost cents, because the industry kept asking what the sand, silver, and aluminum alone were worth.

item.title: Ammonia fertilizer that sells for hundreds of dollars a ton rests on raw inputs whose theoretical floor is a small fraction of that price.
item.description: Ammonia fertilizer that sells for hundreds of dollars a ton rests on raw inputs whose theoretical floor is a small fraction of that price.

item.title: Before containers, moving cargo cost many times the goods themselves because every item had to be handled by hand at each transfer.
item.description: Before containers, moving cargo cost many times the goods themselves because every item had to be handled by hand at each transfer.

item.title: Nuclear plants cost billions, yet their steel, concrete, and fuel are worth only a small fraction of that price.
item.description: Nuclear plants cost billions, yet their steel, concrete, and fuel are worth only a small fraction of that price.
